sufficiency_witness: Every recorded name maps to its own accepted name; nothing merges.
analysis_specification: Rename each counts.tsv column to its taxonomy.csv accepted_name (exact recorded string) and sum columns that share an accepted name. Richness is the number of accepted names with a nonzero total. Mean Bray–Curtis on the merged raw counts over all sample pairs.

assumptions: Neogloboquadrina pachyderma (sinistral) and (dextral) are one species.

reviewer_flaw.attribution_criterion: names the merging of the sinistral and dextral pachyderma columns, which taxonomy.csv maps to two distinct species
